import calendar
from datetime import date, timedelta


def recur(start: str, rule: str, count: int) -> list[str]:
    weekday_codes = ["MO", "TU", "WE", "TH", "FR", "SA", "SU"]
    s = date.fromisoformat(start)
    tokens = rule.split(" ")
    kind = tokens[0]
    out = []

    def add(d):
        if d >= s and len(out) < count:
            out.append(d.isoformat())

    if kind == "DAILY":
        k = int(tokens[1])
        d = s
        while len(out) < count:
            out.append(d.isoformat())
            d += timedelta(days=k)
        return out

    if kind == "WEEKLY":
        k = int(tokens[1])
        wds = sorted({weekday_codes.index(x) for x in tokens[2].split(",")})
        monday = s - timedelta(days=s.weekday())
        j = 0
        while len(out) < count:
            base = monday + timedelta(weeks=j * k)
            for wd in wds:
                add(base + timedelta(days=wd))
            j += 1
        return out

    if kind == "MONTHLY":
        k = int(tokens[1])
        base_m = s.year * 12 + s.month - 1
        j = 0
        while len(out) < count:
            y, mo0 = divmod(base_m + j * k, 12)
            mo = mo0 + 1
            ndays = calendar.monthrange(y, mo)[1]
            if len(tokens) == 3:
                d = int(tokens[2])
                day = ndays if d == -1 else d
                if 1 <= day <= ndays:
                    add(date(y, mo, day))
            else:
                n = int(tokens[2])
                wd = weekday_codes.index(tokens[3])
                if n > 0:
                    first = date(y, mo, 1)
                    day1 = first + timedelta(days=(wd - first.weekday()) % 7)
                    cand = day1 + timedelta(days=7 * (n - 1))
                else:
                    last = date(y, mo, ndays)
                    cand = last - timedelta(days=(last.weekday() - wd) % 7)
                if cand.month == mo:
                    add(cand)
            j += 1
        return out

    if kind == "YEARLY":
        k = int(tokens[1])
        mm, dd = map(int, tokens[2].split("-"))
        j = 0
        while len(out) < count:
            y = s.year + j * k
            if dd <= calendar.monthrange(y, mm)[1]:
                add(date(y, mm, dd))
            j += 1
        return out

    return out
